# Shadowkin
Shadowkin are an extremely rare species that can be mistaken for mammals because of their looks. Most of them resemble canines with two pairs of ears. Despite their familiar appearance, Shadowkin keep to themselves, which has left the unusual phenomena tied to their species largely unstudied.
## Roleplay Guidelines
- Your character's temperament depends on their eye color. - Although you live far longer than any other species, your mind has limits. You remember about 150 to 200 years of your life; the rest is too blurry, comes back in dreams, or flashes up in what humans call "déjà vu". You may still recall someone you know even if you last spoke with them more than 200 years ago.
## Eye Color and Temperament
- Red-eyed Shadowkin: strong and mostly passive-aggressive. They have far less endurance than other Shadowkin but are no weaker than a human. They are driven in part by a hunger for knowledge and a wish for more power. Proud and unused to giving way, they value strength, which usually shows as a wish to hunt and fight as they see fit. They are cunning in their tactics. You may act quite aggressively when you are seriously unhappy with what the crew is doing, but do not overdo the swearing and insults. Most of the time they are calm; playing up their anger is your choice. - Blue-eyed Shadowkin: not physically imposing and of average toughness, but far more resilient in stressful situations. Kind, friendly, curious and open, they often work as scientists and doctors. They are eager to bring as much useful knowledge back to their tribe as they can, and they are the majority of their kind. Their nature leans towards curiosity and friendliness. They pick up Galactic Common much faster than other Shadowkin; if you like, you can play one who does not speak it perfectly. - Yellow-eyed Shadowkin: long-lived and far better informed than the others, but with little interest in the outside world, preferring their home communities. They are the most likely to find a way out of a difficult situation, and over a Shadowkin's long life their temperament always drifts this way. They have no particular build. They are rarer than the other types and more likely to prefer the company of Shadowkin to that of humans. - Green-eyed Shadowkin: a mix of the blue-eyed and yellow-eyed temperaments. Open to conversation, they stand up for their own interests and react badly to the chaos of large crowds. Among their own kind they can rival the blue-eyed and red-eyed in logic. - Purple-eyed Shadowkin: much like the blue-eyed, but far more impulsive and often reckless. They are not openly hostile, but they are more likely to take revenge when wronged or attacked. They make interesting conversation partners, like the blue-eyed, but lean towards narcissism. - Orange-eyed Shadowkin: they show themselves only when they must, and only briefly. They never make the first contact, yet they have the most sensitive and amorous nature of all. They are picky, evasive and cunning.
### White-eyed Shadowkin DO NOT and CANNOT exist on NanoTrasen stations.
